svg.title: Alsace study map
svg.desc: Orientation map with representative study locations and selected rivers and towns. Country and state outlines are geographic context, not appellation boundaries. No vineyard parcels or elevation model are implied. 1: Alsace; 2: Barr; 3: Colmar; 4: Ribeauvillé; 5: Kaysersberg; 6: Turckheim; 7: Eguisheim; 8: Rouffach; 9: Thann; 10: Lauw; 11: Le Hury; 12: Strasbourg

g.text: Light markers: study locations · dark markers: geographic context · teal: water

text.tspan: Follow the land. Compare the wines.
Open this map in the Codex for terroir, grapes, growing, cellar
choices and service. Dots locate places; they do not define a wine

g.text: Natural Earth · GeoNames CC BY 4.0 · representative locations · no appellation boundaries
